How should I format my spreadsheet?

Include a key header and language headers such as ko, en, and ja within the first 10 non-empty rows. Dotted keys such as home.title become nested JSON. Empty translations are omitted. For duplicate keys, the last row wins.

key          ko      en
home.title   안녕하세요   Hello
